6. Door Finish Colors

Search by color name or manufacturer code. Paint / Stain switches the existing finishing option; the current one-tone or two-tone pricing is retained.

Catalog coverage and sources

Paint: 1,946 Sherwin-Williams colors, including Designer and archived colors. Stains: only the six FMD / Masonite finishes from the supplied sample chart — Coffee, Wine, Cinnamon, Toffee, Autumn, and Leather. Selectors work offline.

Stain names identify the finish; no numeric stain codes were provided. Screen colors are approximate. Confirm the physical finish sample before ordering.

SEE IT ON YOUR HOME

Your entrance, your new door

Upload a front-facing photo, then drag the four numbered corners to the outside edges of the entire door frame. Include both doors and any sidelites in the opening. Your selected exterior design updates automatically. Photos stay in this browser.

Choose a door style above, then upload a photo of the entrance.

Corners: 1 top left · 2 top right · 3 bottom right · 4 bottom left. Drag inside the outlined opening to move the whole door. Arrow keys also adjust a focused corner.

Concept rendering for design comparison. Lighting is adjustable; the photo’s existing trim, obstructions and shadows are not automatically removed. Downloaded and printed renderings use the finished door at full opacity.
